smoke.purpose: Short deterministic fixtures for evaluator, CI, and VM smoke gates.

full.purpose: VRChat game/VM qualification fixtures with useful seek and live-window depth.

observed-heavy-v1.purpose: Reproduce the exact media shape used by the in-game high-rate drain failure.

observed-midgop-v1.purpose: Start the observed heavy input on a delta frame and require recovery at the next IDR.

fixture_contract.av/faststart.mp4: H.264/AAC MP4 with moov before mdat
fixture_contract.av/tail-moov.mp4: the same encoded A/V timeline with moov after mdat
fixture_contract.av/fragmented.mp4: fragmented H.264/AAC MP4 with init metadata and moof fragments
fixture_contract.topology/audio-only.m4a: AAC stereo without a video stream
fixture_contract.topology/video-only.mp4: H.264 video without an audio stream
fixture_contract.topology/delayed-audio.mp4: video at zero and the first audio packet at the declared delay
fixture_contract.topology/delayed-video.mp4: audio at zero and the first video packet at the declared delay
fixture_contract.hls/vod/index.m3u8: finite deterministic MPEG-TS HLS with ENDLIST
fixture_contract.hls/live/schedule.json: ordered loopback-server inputs for advancing live windows
fixture_contract.hls/vod-separate/master.m3u8: finite master playlist with independent audio and video renditions
fixture_contract.hls/live-separate/master.m3u8: live master whose independent audio/video windows advance together
fixture_contract.hls/live-separate/schedule.json: hash-bound audio/video window pairs which a VM service publishes atomically
fixture_contract.hls/cmaf/index.m3u8: finite fragmented-MP4 HLS with an initialization map
fixture_contract.rtsp/payload-a-320x180-main-270k.mp4: 45-second H.264 Main/AAC control near 0.37 Mbit/s total
fixture_contract.rtsp/payload-d-1280x720-high-8200k.mp4: bitrate-only step from payload C near 8.3 Mbit/s total
fixture_contract.rtsp/repro-observed-heavy-v1.mp4: 45-second reproduction of the observed 1280x720 High, two-second-GOP, three-B-frame input shape
fixture_contract.rtsp/repro-observed-midgop-v1.mp4: the observed heavy input trimmed to begin on a non-key video frame
fixture_contract.discovery/containers: same-track remuxes plus explicitly named format-native pairs
fixture_contract.discovery/codecs: short reference-discovery members for common Windows/web video codecs
fixture_contract.discovery/audio: 44.1/48 kHz audio-only reference members plus 5.1 and multi-track inputs
fixture_contract.invalid/truncated-faststart.mp4: parseable initialization followed by a truncated mdat
fixture_contract.invalid/truncated-tail.mp4: tail-moov MP4 cut before its metadata
fixture_contract.invalid/missing-segment.m3u8: valid-looking HLS playlist whose only child is absent

marker_contract.video: each frame overlays its zero-based frame number and FFmpeg PTS in hms form
marker_contract.audio_left: continuous 173 Hz carrier plus a first-100-ms marker at 400 + 20 * second Hz
marker_contract.audio_right: continuous 257 Hz carrier plus a first-100-ms marker at 3400 + 20 * second Hz
marker_contract.uniqueness: marker frequencies do not repeat anywhere in the 120-second full profile
